name: Katsuragi Himeno
source:
Hobby: Cooking
Favorite food: [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Soba]Soba[/url].
Hated food: All kinds of delicacies.

Himeno is a second student of Kazami affiliated junior high class 2-1. She is [url=/c5316]Kiyotaka[/url]'s childhood friend who lives in the next room of the same complex as him, and is also a member of the official newspaper club. She is always seen with Kiyotaka, having cared for him from an early age. Many classmates and strangers alike see the pair as brother and sister.

Good at housework, would make the ideal wife but is however easily made jealous. Her personality is depicted as prim and proper by [url=/c5310]Ricca[/url]. She has a crush on Kiyotaka and tries to get him to accept her feelings.
